source: GitHub Engineering Best Practices: SkillUp's own course blueprint, one objective per lesson

tasks.title: Configure branch protection rules that require review, checks and an up-to-date branch
knowledge: Stale approval dismissal vs most-recent-push approval
Required status checks and conversation resolution
skills: Protect a production branch so changes arrive reviewed, tested and current

tasks.title: Control who can bypass branch protection and design break-glass access
knowledge: Admin bypass and 'Do not allow bypassing the above settings'
Ruleset bypass lists: Always allow vs For pull requests only
skills: Design an emergency path that still leaves a pull request trail

tasks.title: Choose between repository rulesets and classic branch protection rules
knowledge: Organization rulesets targeted by name or custom property
skills: Set an organization-wide floor that repositories can only raise

tasks.title: Route and require expert review with CODEOWNERS
knowledge: Base-branch CODEOWNERS and code owner review
skills: Route reviews for risky paths to the right owners and require their approval

tasks.title: Gate merges on status checks, deployments and the merge queue
knowledge: Required status checks and strict mode
skills: Choose merge gates that match a branch's traffic

tasks.title: Enforce centrally owned workflows with organization rulesets
knowledge: Ignored event filters and Evaluate mode
skills: Make a security workflow a gate that target repositories can't weaken

tasks.title: Choose a branching strategy and merge method
knowledge: Linear history and draft pull requests
skills: Pick a branching strategy for a team's release cadence

tasks.title: Enforce branch naming conventions
knowledge: Required naming checks and safe handling of head_ref
skills: Reject branch names that break the convention

tasks.title: Manage the branch lifecycle and protect release tags
skills: Keep branches tidy and released versions immutable

tasks.title: Require signed commits and map branch risks to controls
knowledge: Required signed commits and vigilant mode
skills: Prove commit authorship for audits

tasks.title: Apply least-privilege GITHUB_TOKEN permissions
knowledge: Default token permissions and the permissions key
skills: Give each job only the scopes it needs

tasks.title: Store secrets and variables at the right scope
skills: Keep production credentials out of reach of non-deploy jobs

tasks.title: Deploy to the cloud with OpenID Connect instead of stored keys
knowledge: id-token: write and the OIDC JWT
Trust policy audience and subject conditions
skills: Deploy to a cloud provider without stored keys

tasks.title: Pin and govern third-party actions
skills: Stop a moved tag from changing the code your workflows run

tasks.title: Prevent script injection from untrusted input
knowledge: Expression expansion before the shell runs
skills: Pass untrusted input to scripts safely

tasks.title: Choose and secure GitHub-hosted and self-hosted runners
skills: Provide special hardware without exposing it to untrusted code

tasks.title: Configure Dependabot alerts, security updates and version updates
knowledge: Alerts vs security updates vs version updates
dependabot.yml, groups and the github-actions ecosystem
skills: Keep dependencies patched and current with manageable PR volume

tasks.title: Cache dependencies safely and effectively
skills: Speed up builds without stale or poisoned caches

tasks.title: Run code scanning with CodeQL and make it a merge gate
knowledge: Blocking merges on code scanning results
skills: Turn code scanning alerts into a merge gate

tasks.title: Reuse automation with reusable workflows and composite actions
skills: Share a pipeline stage or a set of steps across repositories

tasks.title: Protect deployments with environments
knowledge: Required reviewers, wait timers and deployment branch rules
skills: Gate production deploys behind approval

tasks.title: Control workflow runs with concurrency, timeouts, matrices and outputs
skills: Solve scheduling, lifetime and data-passing problems with built-in keys

tasks.title: Set up the essential repository files
skills: Give every repository its operating manual and first line of defence

tasks.title: Stop leaked secrets with secret scanning and push protection
skills: Block secrets at push and remediate leaks in the right order

tasks.title: Choose GitHub Secret Protection or Code Security and enforce them with security configurations
knowledge: GitHub Secret Protection vs GitHub Code Security
skills: Buy the right product and enforce a security baseline across repositories

tasks.title: Block vulnerable and non-compliant dependencies with dependency review
skills: Stop pull requests from adding vulnerable or disallowed dependencies

tasks.title: Structure contributions with pull request and issue templates
skills: Capture the context reviewers and triagers need up front

tasks.title: Handle vulnerability reports privately with a security policy
skills: Receive and fix vulnerability reports without public disclosure

tasks.title: Standardize commit messages with Conventional Commits
knowledge: Conventional Commits types and version bumps
Enforcement with commitlint or ruleset metadata rules
skills: Generate versions and changelogs from commit history

tasks.title: Govern visibility, archiving, topics and custom properties
skills: Make repositories findable and targetable by policy

tasks.title: Choose the right machine identity for automation
knowledge: GitHub Apps, deploy keys, PATs and OIDC
skills: Keep automation working when people leave

tasks.title: Audit changes and verify webhook deliveries
skills: Attribute changes and reject forged webhooks
